preset.rule: The sampled pages show a simple illustrated narrative with large pictures and short amounts of text, which matches a storybook better than a textbook or reference work.

renderStrategy.rule: The sampled pages consistently pair a prominent illustration on one side with a text area on the other, making the story template the best fit for responsive reorganization.

pageGrouping.rule: The evidence shows standalone page compositions rather than spreads that rely on crossing the gutter, so each page should be treated independently.

sectioningMode.rule: Each sampled page functions as a self-contained narrative unit, and there is no sign of pages containing multiple distinct activity types that would require splitting.

activitiesGenerator.rule: The book appears to be a read-aloud story with no exercise prompts, questions, or activity signals in the sampled pages or global profile.

figureExtraction.rule: The pages contain full-page style illustrations that are visually important, so creating composite figure candidates is useful, while still leaving ordinary text separate.
